code: scripts/build_ids.py parcel_key(); data/ids/parcel-key.js parcelKey() (tested to agree)

states.IL: Letters and digits, upper case: a county's PINs are fixed width, so dashes, dots and spaces are layout only. Cook County (17031): a 14-digit PIN ending in a 0000 unit is the 10-digit PIN.
states.IN: Digits of the 18-digit state parcel number. A 17-digit number gets its dropped leading zero back only when that makes the first two digits the county's number, (county fips + 1) / 2.
states.WI: Each run of digits without leading zeros, letters kept, joined with '-': counties write the same parcel with and without zero padding.

repeat_sales.rule: market sales by FSLand.saleRows + FSLand.marketSale (field-scout-land.js), one row per sale; a parcel sold 2+ times by that rule
